period_note: P&L-ONLY, no balance sheet available for this quarter. Sourced as the prior-year comparative column inside Trust Bank's own 2014 Q3 unaudited interim financial statement PDF (tblbd.com/about-us/financial-statements) -- the bank's website archive itself only reaches back to 2014, and its interim Balance Sheet always compares the current unaudited date against the immediately preceding audited Dec-31 year-end (never a prior-year same-quarter date), so no 2013 Q1/Q2/Q3 balance-sheet snapshot is recoverable this way. The P&L comparative column, by contrast, IS a same-quarter-prior-year comparison and is fully usable. SOLO / Bank-only basis (same basis as this dataset's main Q4/annual series -- this source document explicitly separates a 'Balance Sheet'/'Profit and Loss Account' section, the Bank-only or 'Solo' statement, from a separate 'Consolidated Balance Sheet'/'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account' section earlier in the same PDF; the SOLO section is the one used here). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year, not discrete-quarter figures, per this source's own column header -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix. No basis mismatch with this bank's main series (contrast with the CONSOLIDATED-basis 2017-2025 quarters sourced from the annual-report-embedded table).
